quest.title: Necessary Procedures
quest.description: The storm in Liyue Harbor has passed, and all aspects of life within the city are slowly undergoing changes... For Ivanovich, this means working hard to adapt to said changes...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x100000, Adventurer's Experience x10

talks.objective: Copy down the bulletin concerning business permits

dialogues.speaker: Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

choices.text: Let's look for information on the Ministry's personnel transfers...

response.speaker: Bulletin Board
response.text: "The Ministry of Civil Affair's personnel transfers are as follows..."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hang on a minute. That's got nothing to do with business permits, does it?

choices.text: Let's look up the status of Feiyun Slope's water supply contamination...

response.speaker: Bulletin Board
response.text: "Regarding the recent contamination of Feiyun Slope's water supply..."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come on, Ivanovich has things to do. We don't have time to be worried about this right now.

choices.text: Let's look for news about new business permit applications...

response.speaker: Bulletin Board
response.text: "If you should wish to apply for a new business permit, you are required to undertake the following procedures..."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This should be the new business permit that Ivanovich wants to apply for. Let's copy the procedures down.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: So, did you find the bulletin concerning the permit?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've copied it down.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Wonderful! Let me have a closer look...

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Exit permit, business premises and safety certificates, and an old business permit...

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: That's fine, that's fine. I got those documents signed a few days ago, and that was an endurance run and a half.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Traveler, could you help me submit each of these documents in their turn as well?

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: That said... *cough* there might be a lot of people looking to submit theirs as well.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: The <color=#00E1FFFF>exit permit</color> must go to Nervous An first. Then, the <color=#00E1FFFF>business premises and safety certificates</color> have to be handed in to a Millelith soldier named Jiayi...

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Finally, the <color=#00E1FFFF>old business permit</color> needs to be given to Clerk Zhao.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Please help me hand these in, Traveler. I will be sure to arrange adequate compensation for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure, sure.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: I really hope this is the end of all these procedures...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Same here.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Well, you probably won't ever have to do so again, but as for me... I'll have to do it again at some point if I want to do business here.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: *sigh* These methods do provide a certain sense of security, yes, but I do wish they could be further simplified.

talks.objective: Give the appropriate documents to Nervous An

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: The paperwork for these procedures is incomplete again...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ivanovich is looking to get a new business permit...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Ivanovich? Oh, yes, I remember him. He's been here a few times.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Applying for a new business permit, is he? Haha... he must be terribly busy right now, then.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: You're here to help him out, I presume. Have you brought his <color=#00E1FFFF>exit permit</color> with you? I do remember telling him before that his paperwork wasn't complete, and that he needed to get it filled in elsewhere...

talks.objective: Give the appropriate documents to Nervous An

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Let me see... No, this isn't correct. I only handle exit permits here. I'm not in charge of any other documents.

talks.objective: Give the appropriate documents to Nervous An

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Let me see... No, this isn't correct. I only handle exit permits here. I'm not in charge of any other documents.

talks.objective: Give the appropriate documents to Nervous An

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Let me see... Yes, this will do. I'll take this document with me, then.

talks.objective: Give the appropriate documents to Jiayi

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Orderly lines please, orderly lines!

choices.text: Ivanovich is looking to get a new business permit...

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: Oh? You're here as his representative? I see. May I have your business premises certificate and... Uh, what was it again? Right — a business safety certificate. Do you have them both with you?

choices.text: You're in charge of these certificates?

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: No, no, I'm ad-hoc help, just like you. Clerk Zhao has her hands full at the moment, so I've been called in to help collect and file those certificates.

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: *sigh* It's really tiring work... So, have you brought both your business premises certificate and business safety certificate?

talks.objective: Give the appropriate documents to Jiayi

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Um, this is the wrong one. I'm only supposed to take business premises and safety certificates.

talks.objective: Give the appropriate documents to Jiayi

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Looks good. I'll file these documents away and pass them to Clerk Zhao later.

talks.objective: Please approach Clerk Zhao about official business during daytime work hours
Give the appropriate documents to Clerk Zhao

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Hello. Anything to submit? Any questions?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ivanovich is looking to get a new business permit...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: You're his representative? Alright. His <color=#00E1FFFF>old business permit</color>, please.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: If you have it, submit it. I'll need it if you want a new one.

talks.objective: Give the appropriate documents to Clerk Zhao

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Mm. Good, I'll take this.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Have you submitted the other documents? You'll have to make another trip in a few days if you haven't.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Good. If everything checks out, the new permit should arrive soon.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: I'll get someone to contact Ivanovich then.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Have you submitted all the documents yet?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They've been submitted.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Phew, that's wonderful. As long as I get a new business permit, I can continue doing business here.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Thank you so much for making the trip on my behalf. Here, take this as compensation, just as we agreed.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: I really hope that I won't ever have to work through so many procedures again... So tiring...

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: I can finally rest for a while. Any more of this and I would have collapsed for sure...

choices.text: What's with the huge number of procedures?

response.speaker: Ivanovich
response.text: Haha. Well, this is Liyue Harbor, after all. Contracts are of utmost importance.

response.speaker: Ivanovich
response.text: Don't we all feel safer when all things big and small are written down in black and white?

response.speaker: Ivanovich
response.text: Well, I say that, but this really is too much. I'm getting dizzy already...

response.speaker: Ivanovich
response.text: You mean in the way we do things? Well, not exactly...

response.speaker: Ivanovich
response.text: But if you want specifics, I could probably go on and on.

response.speaker: Ivanovich
response.text: You'll see what I mean, though, if you ever get the opportunity to set foot in Snezhnaya.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: *sigh* These methods do provide a certain sense of security, yes, but I do wish they could be further simplified.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: This one lacks a stamp, this one lacks proof, and that one's missing some information...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: *sigh* These have to be sent back again...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: So much material, so many files. Whatever will I do if I mix any of them up?

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: These procedures look complete...
